def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (2 duplicates of existing penguin records)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Normalize species case variants (gentoo -> Gentoo, adelie -> Adelie)
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Fix island typos
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().replace({'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'})
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign errors)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    counts = d.groupby('island')['penguin_id'].count()
    return {island: int(n) for island, n in counts.items()}
